messages:
alex: opened PR #6123 that touches runtime batching, platform routing, and network ACLs. Need runtime + platform + infra + security approvals before merge. Pinged owners inline. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/6123 :link:

maya: thanks — can you add a quick summary of risk and the failure mode if we need to revert? Security prefers a short note in the PR description.

cheng: I can review the runtime changes tomorrow morning. what’s the expected tail-latency / p50 delta from this change?

sam: infra side: ACL update looks network-affecting. which commit is that? also need buildkite artifacts to verify.

alex: commit: `b7f3c2a` — artifacts: https://buildkite.com/redwood/repo/builds/2345. Summary in PR: batching default 8->16, routing fallback added, new toggle `enable_sni_strict`. Revert strategy: flip toggle + rollback image.

nina: security here — assigning to myself but need a minimal threat model: dataflow diagram, secret/KMS usage, external endpoints, and any 3rd-party uploads. If you paste that I can do expedited review.

alex: pasted a minimal threat model under PR description `security notes` and added diagram: https://files.redwood/diagrams/pr-6123-threat.pdf. S3 access is scoped to `redwood-uploads-pr`; KMS key arn: `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd`. noted a token exposure vector in the uploader which is fixed in `b7f3c2a`.

cheng: skimmed runtime diff — KV cache and batch sizing look fine. i'll add perf numbers in review comments but lgtm from runtime pending platform/infra/security signoffs.

sam: infra ok with ACL change after reviewing buildkite logs and manifest. left a comment with conditional checks (healthcheck + retry window). tagging @oncall-net for merge window clearance. :white_check_mark:

nina: got the docs and diagram. security approved with one follow-up: add a bearer token rotation test to CI and ensure access logs are retained 30d. marked `security-approved` in the PR.

deploy-bot: buildkite build 2345 passed all stages. merge blocked by branch protection: require 4 approvals.

alex: thanks everyone — re-requested reviewers @maya @cheng @sam @nina. i'll wait for the 4 approvals then merge during today’s maintenance window (22:00 UTC).
